READ THE BOUNDARY

A gap in the model is still a gap.

Keep the Gaps enumerates finite, explicitly declared possibilities. A claim follows only when every remaining assignment satisfies it. If supporting and opposing assignments remain, the claim stays unresolved. If none remain, the premises are inconsistent.

What this does not establish

It does not verify sources, validate a natural-language encoding, discover every omitted variable, estimate probability, measure causal effects, enforce permission, or certify safety. “Observation” is a supplied label, not independent verification. Counts are assignments, not confidence scores.

The browser uses complete checker reports for every combination of the included premises. It supports these three ledgers; it is not a general-purpose truth detector.

Evaluation & reliability

Keep alternative explanations visible rather than grading a claim against an unstated assumption.

Security & authority

Keep a permission claim scoped to what the approval actually authorizes.

Alignment

Explore why authorization alone does not specify intended outcomes. These are distinct questions, not interchangeable categories.
